neighbours.label: a piece of the name of a fibrous or smooth-muscle tumor or fibromyalgia (fib|roids, fib|rom|yal|gia, leiomy|omat|osis, fib|roma), as opposed to other conditions and other 'fib-' words
fire: Many women with uterine fibroids have no symptoms at all.
The biopsy showed a benign fibroma of the ovary.
Her doctor suspects fibromyalgia after months of pain.
Surgery can remove a myoma from the uterine wall.
A neurofibroma is a soft growth along a nerve.
Pelvic pain may be caused by a large fibroid in the womb.
Patients with fibromyalgia often sleep poorly.
The scan found two fibroids and a small lipoma.
quiet: Many women with uterine infections have no symptoms at all.
The biopsy showed a benign cyst of the ovary.
Her doctor suspects arthritis after months of pain.
Surgery can remove a stone from the kidney wall.
A nerve is a bundle of fibers along the spine.
Pelvic pain may be caused by a large stone in the bladder.
Patients with asthma often sleep poorly.
The menu has fiber-rich oats and a small salad.

notes: Probes ranged 0.12 to 1.06, with 'fibroids' far above the rest.
